prompt_en: Create a contemporary luxury wuxia beauty editorial of an unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties, strikingly beautiful and softly charming. Use the portrait only for facial casting: pale skin, tapered oval face, adult-scale gray eyes, slim nose, full rose lips, nose-side beauty mark, and ash-blonde loose half-up hair. Frame a vertical waist-up three-quarter portrait; face large and dominant, gaze oblique toward the adult companion's partial profile and hand at the right edge. An ancient ice-sect master restored to a youthful adult form, she carries centuries of authority through one weathered belt seal and effortless frost. In a restrained modern Northern Sea Ice Palace of clear ice planes and thin silver seams, her same-ranked adult sparring partner has just placed a charcoal training mantle across her shoulders. She maintains a cool unreadable mouth and composed posture. His clearly adult hand withdraws from the mantle edge. She closes two fingers around the cloth, and only her lower eyelids soften toward his departing hand. He pauses in visible surprise while the mantle remains secured. Matching plain black training bracers identify equal peers. Her fingers hold only cloth while his release it; both hands stay simple and separate. One plain straight double-edged jian stands vertically in a wall rack, with wrapped grip, small straight guard, and continuous steel blade clearly readable and separate from every hand. Keep the palace and sword as quiet supporting evidence. Clean translucent planes and broad negative space read as contemporary minimalism. Use an 85mm beauty lens, shallow depth, soft pearl key light, cool rim light, tailored ivory and ice-blue couture, realistic adult skin, and a contemporary fashion-campaign finish.
negative_en: 3D render look, cartoon style, excessive HDR, fake-looking background, low resolution, distorted fingers, broken facial features, body distortion
